boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Hawaii at Manoa
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Honolulu food stops with currently listed late hours. Confirm service format and live availability before leaving campus.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 633 Kapahulu Ave
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Kapahulu
cards.subtitle: 633 Kapahulu Ave, Honolulu
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a late option; the official location page separates it from earlier lobby hours, so check the service format first.
cards.short_summary: A Kapahulu drive-thru listed through 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 633 Kapahulu Ave drive-thru as open until 4:00 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 633 Kapahulu Ave
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru hours until 4:00 a.m. daily; lobby hours end earlier.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 875 Kapiolani Blvd
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Kapiolani
cards.subtitle: 875 Kapiolani Blvd, Honolulu
cards.notes: Plan around the counter or drive-thru distinction. The official listing shows a midnight lobby close on Friday and Saturday and later drive-thru service.
cards.short_summary: A Kapiolani location with late drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists its 875 Kapiolani Blvd drive-thru as operating until 4:00 a.m. daily and its lobby until midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 875 Kapiolani Blvd
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 4:00 a.m. daily; lobby closes at midnight Friday and Saturday and earlier on other days.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 1525 S King St
cards.title: Jack in the Box on South King
cards.subtitle: 1525 S King St, Honolulu
cards.notes: Treat this as a midnight drive-thru stop. If you intend to go inside, the official page lists lobby service ending earlier than the drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: South King Street drive-thru listed until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 1525 S King St drive-thru as open until 12:00 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1525 S King St
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru service until 12:00 a.m. daily; lobby hours end at 10:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 2317 N School St
cards.title: Jack in the Box on North School
cards.subtitle: 2317 N School St, Honolulu
cards.notes: Choose the drive-thru for the late window. The official location page lists service through 4 a.m., while the lobby has an earlier posted close.
cards.short_summary: North School Street drive-thru listed through 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists the 2317 N School St drive-thru as open until 4:00 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 2317 N School St
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours until 4:00 a.m. daily; lobby hours end at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Kapahulu
cards.subtitle: 768 Kapahulu Ave, Honolulu
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery from this listed Kapahulu location. Its official page posts midnight service on Friday and Saturday, with earlier closes on other nights.
cards.short_summary: Pizza carryout or delivery with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists the 768 Kapahulu Ave location open until 12:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday, and until 11:00 p.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant-hours table lists 12:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday and 11:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Wilder
cards.subtitle: 1239 Wilder Ave, Honolulu
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm carryout or delivery before heading over. The listed Friday and Saturday closing time is 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Wilder Avenue pizza option with late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists the 1239 Wilder Ave location open until 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday, and until 10:00 p.m. on other days.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant-hours table lists 11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on North Kuakini
cards.subtitle: 516 N Kuakini St, Honolulu
cards.notes: Check the current ordering channel before travel. The official store page lists an 11 p.m. close on Friday and Saturday and delivery or carryout options.
cards.short_summary: North Kuakini pizza with an 11 p.m. weekend close.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists the 516 N Kuakini St location open until 11:00 p.m. Friday and Saturday, and until 10:00 p.m. on other days.
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant-hours table lists 11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Domino's on Paoakalani
cards.subtitle: 175 Paoakalani Ave, Honolulu
cards.notes: Use the store’s online ordering page for delivery or carryout. The live location listing displayed service until 1 a.m. when checked for this board.
cards.short_summary: A Paoakalani Avenue pizza store listed until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official location page for 175 Paoakalani Ave displayed that the store was open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page displayed “Today Until 1:00 AM.” Check the live store page for the applicable day’s carryout and delivery availability.

cards.title: Domino's on Keeaumoku
cards.subtitle: 934 Keeaumoku St, Honolulu
cards.notes: Use the official store page to place a carryout or delivery order. It is listed by Domino’s as a Honolulu location open until 1 a.m. when checked.
cards.short_summary: A Keeaumoku Street Domino's listed until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Honolulu location listing identifies the store at 934 Keeaumoku St as open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Domino's official Honolulu location listing displayed this store as open until 1:00 a.m.; confirm the live store page before ordering.

cards.title: Domino's at Bishop Street
cards.subtitle: 841 Bishop St, Ste 142, Honolulu
cards.notes: For a late delivery or carryout plan, verify the store page on the day. Domino’s lists this named Honolulu location with a midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Bishop Street Domino's listed until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Honolulu location listing identifies the store at 841 Bishop St, Ste 142 as open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Domino's official Honolulu location listing displayed this store as open until 12:00 a.m.; confirm the live store page before ordering.
